description: Unit tests for the ConnectionId class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package, verifying immutability, equals/hashcode methods, dummy ID behavior, random ID generation, and string representation.

classes.name: ConnectionIdTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ConnectionId class behaviors.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ConnectionId class is immutable, assuming EntityId is also immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations in ConnectionId class.

methods.name: placeholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests that the dummy ConnectionId returns true for isDummy().

methods.name: manuallyCreatedPlaceholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests that a ConnectionId created with '_' is identified as dummy.

methods.name: randomlyGeneratedIsNoPlaceholder
methods.description: Ensures that a randomly generated ConnectionId is not considered a dummy.

methods.name: randomlyGeneratedIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the string representation of a random ConnectionId is not empty.

methods.name: connectionIdOfConnectionIdIsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that copying a ConnectionId results in the same instance.

methods.name: toStringEqualsInput
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method returns the expected string.
